## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 of top performers are Technology); confirmation: Technology and large-cap Tech names are net positive (AAPL (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +7.33%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +11.07%) ABOVE TREND) while Healthcare and Utilities show clear weakness (Healthcare 1W: -2.31%, JNJ (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -3.91%) BELOW TREND), supporting a neutral, selective stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads with big weekly movers: AMD (1W: +11.53% | 1M: +41.31%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +21.46%) ABOVE TREND; Communication strength is visible via CHTR (1W: +12.24% | 1M: +13.59%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare strength is concentrated in UNH (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +25.55%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities, Healthcare and Industrials are lagging: Utilities (1W: -3.58%) showing weakness with CEG (1W: -6.38% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND; Healthcare (1W: -2.31%) has large names under pressure like MRK (1W: -6.17% | 1M: -1.42%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND. Industrials show dispersion with GE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -0.02%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NOW (1W: +14.07% | 1M: -9.28%) RECOVERY, CHTR (1W: +12.24% | 1M: +13.59%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.53% | 1M: +41.31%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +21.46%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MRK (1W: -6.17% | 1M: -1.42%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -6.38% | 1M: -1.52%) BELOW TREND, LMT (1W: -6.48% | 1M: -8.84%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND, MDT (1W: -6.95% | 1M: -4.05%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Healthcare and parts of Industrials/Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Big 1W momentum: NOW (1W: +14.07% | 1M: -9.28%) RECOVERY, CHTR (1W: +12.24% | 1M: +13.59%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.53% | 1M: +41.31%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.47% | 1M: +12.29%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +21.46%) ABOVE TREND — note MAJOR divergence present (multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M such as NOW, INTU, CRM, GOOGL), so watch for trend breaks rather than assuming broad continuation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is constructive but concentrated: AAPL (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +7.33%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +11.07%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +15.74%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.53% | 1M: +41.31%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +10.40%) CORRECTION — sector shows strong upside but with narrow leadership and select short-term corrections.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are broadly positive but mixed: JPM (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +9.79%) ABOVE TREND while SCHW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: -2.84%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -0.46% | 1M: +2.76%) CORRECTION, indicating outperformance by banks/payments leaders but idiosyncratic weakness persists.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is bifurcated: UNH (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +25.55%) ABOVE TREND driving sector upside pockets while JNJ (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -3.91%) BELOW TREND, MRK (1W: -6.17% | 1M: -1.42%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.41%) BELOW TREND leave the sector vulnerable.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to high-conviction Financials and leading Tech names (e.g., MSFT (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +11.07%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.53% | 1M: +41.31%) ABOVE TREND) and favor UNH (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +25.55%) ABOVE TREND for sector strength; reduce exposure to lagging defensives and pressured Healthcare names (JNJ (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -3.91%) BELOW TREND, MRK (1W: -6.17% | 1M: -1.42%) BELOW TREND). Style: mixed — narrow Growth pockets within a neutral market.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: UNH (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +25.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.53% | 1M: +41.31%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +11.15% | 1M: +21.46%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GE (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -0.02%) BELOW TREND, RTX (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -5.55%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -12.89% | 1M: +0.83%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +5.31% | 1M: +11.50%) and Financials (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +10.14%) — both positive but leadership narrow. BEARISH: Healthcare (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +1.31%) and Utilities (1W: -3.58% | 1M: +1.54%) where downside pressure could persist.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +15.74%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through above recent monthly highs to confirm continuation; monitor AAPL (1W: +2.84% | 1M: +7.33%) ABOVE TREND for any weekly momentum failure; UNH (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +25.55%) ABOVE TREND needs follow-through to validate earnings-led breakout; if NOW (1W: +14.07% | 1M: -9.28%) loses weekly gains, treat as failed recovery.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (+60): earnings/outlook beat; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +25.55%) — sentiment confirmed. GOOGL (+55): AI chip tie-up; price CORRECTION (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +10.40%) — positive news but short-term pullback (distribution risk). RTX (+55): guidance/industrial strength; price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.71% | 1M: -5.55%) — sentiment positive but price lagging (watch for catch-up).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AMZN (-60): legal headwind; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +21.69%) — negative news diverging from price (distribution risk). GE (-50): earnings shock; price BELOW TREND (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -0.02%) — sentiment confirmed. LLY (-45): Medicare rollout delay; price BELOW TREND (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.41%) — sentiment and price aligned.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style — narrow Growth pockets within a neutral market, favor selective Financials and Tech. UNH (1W: +10.13% | 1M: +25.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.53% | 1M: +41.31%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +7.90% | 1M: +11.07%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is MAJOR divergence across large caps (NOW, INTU, CRM, GOOGL) and mixed news flow on AMZN/LLY — monitor for trend breaks before broad allocation shifts.
